name: mail_accounts
title: Mail Accounts
description: One IMAP mailbox a person asked this server to copy into their inbox. The password is deliberately NOT a field: a record is readable, listable, exported and backed up, and a secret must be none of those (docs/secrets-and-credentials.md). It lives in the owner's identity vault under the service name imap-<this account's id>, written through PUT /identity/users/{user_id}/service-keys and never readable back; the /mail/accounts page shows only whether it is set. The sync_* fields and last_synced_at belong to system_mail_sync: last_synced_at is when the account was last found up to date (refreshed at most hourly while nothing arrives, so an idle account does not rewrite its row every pass), sync_started_at/sync_finished_at are the claim a pass holds while it writes, and sync_attempts/sync_error say how many passes in a row have failed and what the server said. sync_attempts is the one status field the owner may write: setting it to 0 skips the wait after failures and tries again on the next pass.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Name
fields.help: What you call this mailbox, for example Work.

fields.name: email_address
fields.label: Email address
fields.help: Mail sent from this address is shown as sent by you.

fields.name: host
fields.label: IMAP server
fields.help: A host name such as imap.example.com, no https:// and no port.

fields.name: port
fields.label: Port
fields.help: Blank means 993 for ssl and 143 for starttls.

fields.name: security
fields.label: Security
fields.help: ssl (port 993) or starttls (port 143). plain sends the password unencrypted and is refused for anything but this machine itself.

fields.name: folders
fields.label: Folders
fields.help: Comma-separated. Blank means INBOX plus the Sent folder, found on the first sync and written here.

fields.name: sync_attempts
fields.label: Failed syncs in a row
fields.help: Set to 0 to try again at once instead of waiting.
